fact: The National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences signed a cooperation protocol with the Agricultural Research Center of the Ministry of Agriculture to run research and applied projects using AI and remote sensing, including inventory and growth tracking of field and horticultural crops, irrigation-water use and pest and disease forecasting.
title: بروتوكول تعاون بين الهيئة القومية للاستشعار من البعد ومركز البحوث الزراعية
